resources.string: RemotePhone uses this service to turn taps, swipes and key presses sent from the controlling phone into real touches on this phone, while a remote session is active. Nothing is injected unless you accepted a session.
What it can and cannot do

No root needed. While a session is live you will see a persistent notification and can stop it any time. It cannot unlock the lock screen, and it cannot touch some secure system dialogs (for example permission prompts) — those need a human finger on this phone.
